posts.body:
Your umbrella flips inside out. Instead of explaining the whole disaster, start here:

我的伞坏了。
Wǒ de sǎn huài le.
My umbrella broke.

坏了 (huài le) works for things that have broken or stopped working.

Mini-fable: The fox blamed the waiter when his chopsticks rolled off the table. Then he noticed his own elbow had tipped the plate.

筷子掉了。
Kuàizi diào le.
The chopsticks fell.

掉了 (diào le) describes what happened. It leaves the culprit open.
